notes: Article URLs point to the canonical English Wikipedia article for the underlying game. Platform, region, revision, or build qualifiers in a project key identify a specific research target; the article may describe the game generally.
Two GitHub project records share the exact game key “Final Fantasy Tactics (PlayStation USA SCUS-94221)”; the manifest includes that key once.

“Halo: Combat Evolved (Xbox original)” is a distinct, currently unlinked profile key, but it refers to the same game already represented by other linked Halo profile keys. Its entry reuses the canonical Halo: Combat Evolved article.
“Resident Evil: Deadly Silence (Nintendo DS USA ABHE)” links to the Resident Evil (1996 video game) article, which has a dedicated “Deadly Silence” section describing the Nintendo DS port.

“Road Rash (1996 Windows rerelease)” links to the Road Rash (1991 video game) article, which describes the original game and later platform ports; no standalone article for the Windows rerelease was verified.
“Joust (Atari ST)” and “Buggy Boy (Atari ST)” link to the game articles that identify the Atari ST versions in their platform/release coverage.
“Stretch Panic” is the North American title; the article notes the Freak Out title used in Japan and Europe/Oceania.

Special:Search fallbacks are used for Eyeshield 21 DS, Fairy Tail: Kardia, Farming Simulator 15, George of the Jungle and the Search for the Secret, Medabots: Rokusho, Tetris: The Absolute – The Grand Master 2 Plus, and the specific Touhou 6 release because no clearly matching standalone English Wikipedia article was verified for those exact targets.

The Tetris fallback is scoped to The Grand Master 2 Plus and its Psikyo PS5V2 arcade target. The broader Tetris: The Grand Master article mentions Plus as an update but is not a dedicated article for this specific release.
